name: Format
description_en:
Format is a hosted portfolio website service for photographers, artists, designers and filmmakers. It combines image-led themes and Flex Block layouts with client galleries, file transfers and, on relevant plans, a store and light client-management tools. The product is centered on presenting creative work and serving clients rather than operating a general-purpose custom application.

Choose a plan around portfolio size, video minutes, gallery and delivery limits. Hosting and SSL are included, while domain registration and branded email have separate renewal economics. The public pricing page currently advertises first-year annual promotions and contains a conflicting Basic gallery allowance, which should be resolved before purchase.
description_zh:
Format 是面向摄影师、艺术家、设计师和电影创作者的托管作品集网站服务。它将以图片为主的主题和 Flex Block 布局，与客户图库、文件传输，以及相应方案中的商店和轻量客户管理结合。其核心是展示创作成果与服务客户。

应按作品集规模、视频分钟数、图库和交付限制选择方案。托管和 SSL 已包含，域名注册与品牌邮件有单独的续费成本。公开定价页当前宣传首年年付优惠，同时 Basic 图库数量存在冲突，购买前需要澄清。

core_features.explanation_en: Responsive themes and Flex Block support visual portfolios; optional HTML/CSS refinement is described for Pro and Pro Plus.
core_features.explanation_zh: 响应式主题与 Flex Block 支持视觉作品集，Pro 和 Pro Plus 另可使用 HTML/CSS 微调。

core_features.explanation_en: Plans have gallery and file-transfer limits; Pro and Pro Plus add CRM Light and contracts according to the pricing FAQ.
core_features.explanation_zh: 方案设有图库和文件传输限制；定价 FAQ 表示 Pro 与 Pro Plus 增加 CRM Light 和合同。

core_features.name_zh: 整站与页面 SEO 编辑
core_features.explanation_en: Edit homepage and individual page titles/descriptions, image descriptions and an automatically generated sitemap; search presentation remains controlled by search engines.
core_features.explanation_zh: 可编辑首页和各页面标题/描述、图片说明，并提供自动生成的网站地图；搜索展示仍由搜索引擎决定。

pricing.summary_en: 14-day trial; displayed annual monthly equivalents $10/$12/$15 for Basic/Pro/Pro Plus include conditional first-year Pro promotions. Monthly alternatives $14/$24/$36; domain/email costs and renewal require separate review.
pricing.summary_zh: 14 天试用；Basic/Pro/Pro Plus 年付月均显示 $10/$12/$15，其中 Pro 系列含有条件首年优惠；月付替代为 $14/$24/$36，域名/邮件及续费需另核。

review_notes: Original English synthesis and corresponding Chinese translation from the attached primary sources. Vendor documentation does not establish independent testing or customer outcomes.
Original directory feature labels were replaced with product-specific documented capabilities. Unknowns and unreviewed alternatives remain unknown.

sections.title_en: Build around a small body of representative work
sections.title_zh: 先用一组代表作品搭建
sections.en: Start the 14-day no-card trial with a small, permission-cleared collection rather than uploading the entire archive. Choose a responsive theme, use Flex Block where custom composition matters, and inspect desktop/mobile presentation and image descriptions. Add a client gallery and a sample delivery to check whether the workflow matches the practice. Pro lists 1,500 high-resolution images, 100 GB storage and 15 hosted video minutes; Pro Plus lists unlimited high-resolution images, 1 TB and 120 minutes. Unlimited image count does not erase storage or video limits.
sections.zh: 可在 14 天免银行卡试用中先使用一组已获授权的代表作品，避免一开始上传全部档案。选择响应式主题，在需要定制构图处使用 Flex Block，并检查桌面/手机展示及图片说明。增加一个客户图库和样例交付，判断流程是否符合实际工作。Pro 列出 1,500 张高清图片、100 GB 存储和 15 分钟托管视频；Pro Plus 列出不限高清图片数量、1 TB 和 120 分钟。图片数量不限不代表存储或视频无限。

sections.title_en: Compare limits and first-year pricing separately
sections.title_zh: 分别比较用量与首年价格
sections.en: The captured page displays Basic at $10/month billed annually, Pro at $12 and Pro Plus at $15, with monthly alternatives of $14/$24/$36. Pro and Pro Plus promotional codes apply to new annual subscriptions for the first year only, redeemable by October 31, 2026 at 11:59 p.m. PST; confirm renewal rates and currency code at checkout. Basic has 10 pages and 70 high-resolution images. Pro/Pro Plus list unlimited pages and 15/1,000 store products. File transfers are 2/5/10 GB across the tiers. The Basic card says 10 client galleries while the comparison row says 3; do not rely on either number until Format confirms the account allowance.
sections.zh: 实读页面年付月均显示 Basic $10、Pro $12、Pro Plus $15；月付替代价为 $14/$24/$36。Pro 和 Pro Plus 优惠码仅适用于新年付订阅首年，兑换截止为 2026 年 10 月 31 日 23:59 PST；续费价及货币代码应在结账确认。Basic 含 10 页和 70 张高清图片，Pro/Pro Plus 列出不限页面与 15/1,000 件商店商品。三个方案文件传输上限为 2/5/10 GB。Basic 卡片写 10 个客户图库，比较行却写 3 个，Format 确认账户额度前不能依赖任一数字。

sections.title_en: Connect the portfolio without losing domain control
sections.en: The domain guide requires a Format Address, the existing custom domain added under Domain and Email, and the registrar’s DNS records configured according to the current help article. It specifies root A and AAAA records plus a www CNAME, using the registrar’s default nameservers; use registrar-specific guidance for a different setup. A domain already connected to another Format site must be disconnected there first. Propagation can take 48 hours; escalate a persistent failed connection after that interval. Test both apex and www URLs and preserve mail settings during a real migration. This review did not edit DNS.
sections.zh: 域名指南要求设置 Format Address，在 Domain and Email 中添加已有域名，再按当前帮助文章配置注册商 DNS。指南指定根域 A、AAAA 及 www CNAME，并要求注册商默认 nameserver；不同设置应参考注册商专项指南。已连接其他 Format 网站的域名需要先在那里断开。传播可能需要 48 小时，之后持续失败应联系支持。真实迁移应测试根域和 www，并保护邮件设置。本次没有修改 DNS。

sections.title_zh: 为图片页面补充有效文字
sections.en: In Settings → SEO, set a descriptive homepage title and description, then use the content editor to fill individual page metadata. Add image descriptions separately from visible captions and review the generated sitemap. The guide warns that search updates may take days and that Google can rewrite titles. These controls help explain the portfolio to people and crawlers; they do not substantiate a promised ranking or traffic increase. Review captions and accessibility on the actual chosen template because image-description support depends on image type and current themes.
sections.zh: 在 Settings → SEO 中设置具体的首页标题和描述，再使用内容编辑器补齐各页面元数据。图片说明与可见题注分开填写，并检查自动生成的网站地图。指南提醒搜索更新可能需要数天，Google 也可能重写标题。这些控制有助于用户和抓取工具理解作品集，不支持排名或流量增长承诺。图片说明支持依赖图片类型及当前主题，应在所选模板检查题注与无障碍效果。

sections.title_en: Budget ongoing business use and portability
sections.title_zh: 核算持续业务使用及迁移
sections.en: Format includes hosting and SSL. The FAQ lists domain registration at $30/year with the first year free on Pro/Pro Plus annual plans, and Google Workspace branded email at $100/year. A commission-free store claim does not establish zero payment-processor, tax or fulfillment costs. Cancellation before renewal is documented, but the sources do not establish a prorated refund. This is a reasonable shortlist for a visual practice that wants portfolio and client delivery together; teams needing self-hosting or a fully portable application should first obtain explicit code/data export and license terms. No gallery, checkout, delivery, export or account workflow was executed here.
sections.zh: Format 包含托管和 SSL。FAQ 列出域名注册 $30/年，Pro/Pro Plus 年付首年免费；Google Workspace 品牌邮件 $100/年。商店免佣金的描述不证明支付处理、税务或履约成本为零。文档允许续费前取消，但未确立按比例退款。希望将作品集与客户交付结合的视觉创作团队可将其纳入候选；需要自托管或完整可迁移应用的团队应先取得明确代码/数据导出和许可条款。本次未执行图库、结账、交付、导出或账户流程。
